query_analysis.original_query: I need to develop a comprehensive predictive model for solids discharge in our nozzle discharge solid-bowl centrifuge. What factors should we prioritize to minimize operational instabilities?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Develop a predictive model for solids discharge in a nozzle discharge solid-bowl centrifuge, identifying key factors that contribute to operational instabilities and prioritizing those for mitigation.

selected_agents.role: Operational stability analysis and control strategy

communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Integrated model refinement and control strategy design

clarification_questions: What are the specific characteristics of the solids being separated (particle size distribution, density, etc.)?
What are the typical operating conditions of the centrifuge (feed rate, rotational speed, nozzle size, etc.)?
What type of operational instabilities are you currently experiencing?
